```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)

```

```{r}
# Path to your GSE folder
folder <- "../../GSE117295_RAW/"

# List all CSV files in the folder
files <- list.files(folder, pattern = "_CT[0-9]+.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Create a list to store Seurat objects for each timepoint
seurat_list <- list()

for (f in files) {
  # Use filename (without extension) as timepoint ID
  timepoint <- stringr::str_extract(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f)), pattern = "(?<=CT).*")
  
  # Read in the CSV
  dat <- read.csv(f, row.names = 1) 
  
  ## --- CHECK FOR DUPLICATED BARCODES WITHIN THIS TIMEPOINT ---
  dupes <- duplicated(colnames(dat))
  if (any(dupes)) {
    message("WARNING: duplicated barcodes found in file ", basename(f))
    print(colnames(dat)[dupes])
  } else {
    message("OK: no duplicated cell barcodes within ", basename(f))
  }
  ## -----------------------------------------------------------
  
  # Create Seurat object
  seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = dat, project = timepoint)
  
  # Add metadata for timepoint
  seu$timepoint <- as.numeric(timepoint)
  
  # Store in list
  seurat_list[[timepoint]] <- seu
}

# Add orig.ident as a postfix to cell names for each object in the list
seurat_list <- lapply(seurat_list, function(obj) {
  RenameCells(obj, new.names = paste0(colnames(obj), "_", obj$orig.ident))
})

# Merge all Seurat objects into one
combined <- merge(seurat_list[[1]], y = seurat_list[-1])

# Check metadata
head(combined@meta.data)

```

```{r}
# How many GEO cells share the same bare?

# Helper: lookup count with NA → 0
lookup_count <- function(x, tab) {
  out <- tab[x]
  out[is.na(out)] <- 0
  as.integer(out)
}

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Build SCN dataframe
# ----------------------------------------------------
scn_df <- tibble(
  raw  = SCN_raw,
  bare = SCN_bare,

  # How many GEO cells match the SCN raw barcode?
  n_geo_raw  = lookup_count(SCN_raw, raw_to_geo_n),

  # How many GEO cells match the bare barcode?
  n_geo_bare = lookup_count(SCN_bare, bare_to_geo_n),

  # Does the SCN raw barcode exist in GEO exactly?
  match_raw_exact  = n_geo_raw == 1,

  # If raw doesn't match, sometimes bare matches uniquely
  match_bare_exact = n_geo_raw == 0 & n_geo_bare == 1,

  # Barcodes that cannot be resolved:
  ambiguous = (n_geo_raw > 1) | (n_geo_bare > 1),

  # No match at all?
  no_match = (n_geo_raw == 0 & n_geo_bare == 0)
)
```

Custom cycling functions, ignore as batches are taken every 12 hours in this data, so adding batch to var_cycling will necessarily produce non linearly independent columns in the design matrix.

```{r}

is_cycling_custom <- function(times, pb_mat,meta_data, time_units = "hrs") {
  `%do%` <- foreach::`%do%`
  cat(paste("\nRunning is_cycling_custom()"))
  gene1 = t(pb_mat)  # get the transpose, subjects x genes and put in order of CYCLOPS order
   if(time_units == "hrs"){
   cat(paste("\nRunning regression, converting hours to radians"))
   times1 = times / 12 * pi
  } else{
    cat(paste("\nRunning regression assuming times are 0-2pi radians"))
    times1 = times
  }
  batches = meta_data$batch[match(colnames(pb_mat), meta_data$timepoint)] %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.factor()

    #loop:
  all_genes = foreach (gene_i = 1:ncol(gene1), .combine = rbind) %do%{
    gexp1 = as.numeric(unlist(gene1[,gene_i]))
    Gene_Symbols = colnames(gene1)[gene_i]
    # Check for all zeros or zero variance
    if (all(gexp1 == 0) || sd(gexp1) == 0) {
      # Return NA row for this gene
      return(c(Gene_Symbols, rep(NA, 11))) # columns to match the number of outputs
    }

    partial_model = lm(gexp1 ~ batches)
    partial_model_AIC = AIC(partial_model)
    partial_model_BIC = BIC(partial_model)

    full_model = lm(gexp1 ~ sin(times1) + cos(times1)+batches )
    full_model_AIC = AIC(full_model)
    full_model_BIC = BIC(full_model)

    design_matrix <- model.matrix(gexp1 ~ sin(times1) + cos(times1)+batches)

    anova_results = anova(partial_model, full_model)
    sin_coff = full_model[["coefficients"]][["sin(times1)"]]
    cos_coeff = full_model[["coefficients"]][["cos(times1)"]]
    acrophase_bulk = atan2(sin_coff, cos_coeff) %% (2*pi)

    p_statistic = anova_results$`Pr(>F)`[2]
    amplitude_bulk = sqrt(sin_coff^2 + cos_coeff^2)

    mesor_bulk = mean(design_matrix[,-c(2, 3)] %*% full_model[["coefficients"]][-c(2, 3)])
    # mesor_bulk = full_model$coefficients[["(Intercept)"]]

    amp_ratio = amplitude_bulk / mesor_bulk



   gene_summary = cbind( Gene_Symbols, acrophase_bulk,amplitude_bulk,
              p_statistic, amp_ratio, sin_coff, cos_coeff, mesor_bulk,
              partial_model_AIC, full_model_AIC, partial_model_BIC, full_model_BIC)

    return(gene_summary)

  }
  all_genes = as_tibble(all_genes) %>% drop_na
  all_genes$BHQ = p.adjust(as.numeric(all_genes$p_statistic), "BH")
  all_genes$Bonf = p.adjust(as.numeric(all_genes$p_statistic), "bonferroni")
  return(all_genes)

}
```

```{r}

s_obj = prepare_seurat_for_orpheus(seurat_obj = joined_seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", min_prop = 0.001)

#     s_obj$neuron_subcluster == "avp/nms" ~ "shell",
#     TRUE ~ s_obj$neuron_subcluster
#   )

orpheus_inputs = calculate_orpheus_inputs(s_obj, groups_to_analyze = names(table(s_obj$neuron_subcluster)), grouping_var = "neuron_subcluster")


# #I need to make sure all the times/batch are equal among individual_ID:
# s_obj@meta.data %>%
#   group_by(orig.ident) %>%
#   summarise(
#     across(c(batch, timepoint), ~n_distinct(.x))
#   ) %>% View

#Since assumption is correct, this code below correctly gets metadata for each subject:
subject_meta <- s_obj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(orig.ident) %>%
  summarise(
    batch = first(batch),
    timepoint = first(timepoint)  )

cluster_phis = list()
for(cell_type in names(orpheus_inputs)){
  
print(paste("Analyzing condition", cell_type))


tmp = orpheus_inputs[[cell_type]]
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]


vars = sparseMatrixStats::rowVars(counts)
means = sparseMatrixStats::rowMeans2(counts)
agg_theta_meas = data.frame(coarse_theta = (vars-means)/means^2)
rownames(agg_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)


#Recover time in hours that sample was collected

matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
print(ZT)

#Call cosinor regression methods, where phases of variance wave are fixed:
# pb_cycling1 = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat, time_units = "hrs")
pb_cycling = is_cycling_custom(ZT, pb_mat, meta_data = subject_meta, time_units = "hrs")
# test = merge(pb_cycling1, pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffixes = c("", "_batch")) %>%   mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric))
# plot(test$acrophase_bulk, test$acrophase_bulk_batch)

phase_pb = pb_cycling %>% select(Gene_Symbols, acrophase_bulk)

var_mat = var_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]
pb_mat = pb_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]

stopifnot(all(rownames(pb_mat) == pb_cycling$Gene_Symbols))
stopifnot(all(rownames(pb_mat) == rownames(var_mat)))

phase_pb_num = phase_pb$acrophase_bulk %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric
#hist(as.numeric(phase_pb))

var_cyclers = var_cycling_fix_acro(times = ZT, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = phase_pb_num)
# var_cyclers = var_cycling(times = ZT, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = phase_pb_num)


bulk_amp_thr = 0.05

input_cos = var_cyclers %>% 
    left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix=c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
   # mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_amp_thr) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)

phi <- tryCatch(
  {
    calc_phi(pb_cycling, var_cyclers, cycling_p_thr = 0.05, bulk_amp_thr = bulk_amp_thr)
  },
  error = function(e) {
    message("calc_phi failed: ", e$message)
    return(NA)   
  }
)
if(all(is.na(phi))){
 next
}

# plot_rhythms(ZT, var_mat, pb_mat, plot_me = c("Akap17b"))

output_cos_tmm = merge(phi, input_cos, by = 0)
# output = merge(output_cos_tmm, time_wise_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)
output = merge(output_cos_tmm, agg_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)


local_res =  list("tmm" = output)
names(local_res) =cell_type
cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))

}
```

```{r}
  current_df <- cluster_phis[[source_name]][[1]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_phis[[source_name]][1])
  current_df
}))
```

### Repeat With Pseudoreplicates

```{r}
s_obj = prepare_seurat_for_orpheus(seurat_obj = joined_seurat_obj, assay = "RNA" )

s_obj@meta.data$neuron_subcluster_coarse <- case_when(
    s_obj$neuron_subcluster == "cck/bdnf" ~ "cck",
    s_obj$neuron_subcluster == "vip/nms" ~ "vip",
    s_obj$neuron_subcluster == "cck/c1ql3" ~ "cck",
    s_obj$neuron_subcluster == "vip/grp" ~ "vip",
    TRUE ~ s_obj$neuron_subcluster
  )


s_obj@meta.data$core_shell <- case_when(
    s_obj$neuron_subcluster == "vip/nms" ~ "core",
    s_obj$neuron_subcluster == "vip/grp" ~ "core",
    s_obj$neuron_subcluster == "cck/bdnf" ~ "shell",
    s_obj$neuron_subcluster == "cck/c1ql3" ~ "shell",
    s_obj$neuron_subcluster == "avp/nms" ~ "shell",
    TRUE ~ s_obj$neuron_subcluster
  )

subject_meta <- s_obj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(orig.ident) %>%
  summarise(
    batch = first(batch),
    timepoint = first(timepoint)  )

pseudorep_meta <- subject_meta[rep(seq_len(nrow(subject_meta)), each = 2), ]

seeds <- c(1,2,3,4)
#Initialize an empty list to store all results
all_results_combined <- list()
for(i in seeds){
  message(paste("--- Running ORPHEUS with seed:", i, "---"))
    
    # returns a list like: list('CellTypeA' = ..., 'CellTypeB' = ...)
    results_one_seed <- calculate_orpheus_inputs(
      s_obj, 
      groups_to_analyze = c("shell", "core"), 
      grouping_var = "core_shell", 
      num_replicates = 2, 
      random_seed = i
    )
    
    
    # Modify the names to include the seed identifier
    # prevents name clashes when we combine the lists.
    original_names <- names(results_one_seed)
    new_names <- paste0(original_names, "_seed", i)
    names(results_one_seed) <- new_names
    
    # Append the newly named results to main list
    all_results_combined <- c(all_results_combined, results_one_seed)
}
# Check the names of the final combined list
print("Names of the final combined list:")
print(names(all_results_combined))
save(all_results_combined, file = "mouse_SCN_4_seeds_pb_var_counts_list.RData")
#######Load results from above #######
load("mouse_SCN_4_seeds_pb_var_counts_list.RData")

cluster_phis = list()
for(cell_type in names(all_results_combined)){
  
print(paste("Analyzing", cell_type))


# tmp = extract_clstr_prep_input(seurat_obj, cluster_id = cell_type, clip_sd = 15, normalize = T)
tmp = all_results_combined[[cell_type]]
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]


vars = sparseMatrixStats::rowVars(counts)
means = sparseMatrixStats::rowMeans2(counts)
agg_theta_meas = data.frame(coarse_theta = (vars-means)/means^2)
rownames(agg_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)


#Recover time in hours that sample was collected
matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
print(ZT)

#rename cols to use is_cycling_custom
colnames(pb_mat) = str_replace(colnames(pb_mat), "_rep[1-9]*", "") 
stopifnot(all.equal(as.numeric(colnames(pb_mat)), ZT))

#Call cosinor regression methods, where phases of variance wave are fixed:
# pb_cycling1 = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat, time_units = "hrs")
pb_cycling = is_cycling_custom(ZT, pb_mat, meta_data = pseudorep_meta, time_units = "hrs")
# test = merge(pb_cycling1, pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffixes = c("", "_batch")) %>%   mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric))
# plot(test$acrophase_bulk, test$acrophase_bulk_batch)

phase_pb = pb_cycling %>% select(Gene_Symbols, acrophase_bulk)

var_mat = var_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]
pb_mat = pb_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]

stopifnot(all(rownames(pb_mat) == pb_cycling$Gene_Symbols))
stopifnot(all(rownames(pb_mat) == rownames(var_mat)))

phase_pb_num = phase_pb$acrophase_bulk %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric
#hist(as.numeric(phase_pb))

var_cyclers = var_cycling_fix_acro(times = ZT, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = phase_pb_num)

bulk_amp_thr = 0.05

input_cos = var_cyclers %>% 
    left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix=c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
    # mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_amp_thr) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)

phi <- tryCatch(
  {
    calc_phi(pb_cycling, var_cyclers, cycling_p_thr = 0.05, bulk_amp_thr = bulk_amp_thr)
  },
  error = function(e) {
    message("calc_phi failed: ", e$message)
    return(NA)   
  }
)
if(all(is.na(phi))){
 next
}

# plot_rhythms(ZT, var_mat, pb_mat, plot_me = c("Akap17b"))

# output = merge(output_cos_tmm, time_wise_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)
output = merge(output_cos_tmm, agg_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)


local_res =  list("tmm" = output)
names(local_res) =cell_type
cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))
}
```

### COMBAT: Remove batch effects in expression then do cycling analysis

```{r}
library(sva)

log_norm_counts <- log1p(s_obj@assays$ORPHEUS_norm$counts)  # log(1 + x)

batches = s_obj@meta.data$batch

combat_corrected <- ComBat(
  dat = as.matrix(log_norm_counts),
  batch = batches,
  par.prior = TRUE,
  prior.plots = FALSE
)

combat_corrected_exp <- expm1(combat_corrected)

s_obj[["ORPHEUS_norm_ComBat_logged"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = combat_corrected)
s_obj[["ORPHEUS_norm_ComBat"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = combat_corrected_exp)

#How well are the pseudobulks correlated?
pb_cor_list <- lapply(seq_along(orpheus_inputs), function(i) {
  dfA <- orpheus_inputs[[i]][[1]]
  dfB <- orpheus_inputs_combat[[i]][[1]]

  # Check dimensions match
  if (!all(dim(dfA) == dim(dfB))) {
    stop(paste("Dimensions differ in sublist", i))
  }

  # Compute correlation between corresponding rows
  # Transpose since cor() computes column correlations by default
  sapply(seq_len(nrow(dfA)), function(j) cor(unname(unlist(dfA[j, ])), unname(unlist(dfB[j, ]))))
})

#How well are the gene variances correlated?

  sapply(seq_len(nrow(dfA)), function(j) cor(unname(unlist(dfA[j, ])), unname(unlist(dfB[j, ]))))
})

jaccard <- function(a, b) {
    intersection = length(intersect(a, b))
    union = length(a) + length(b) - intersection
    return (intersection/union)
}
```

### BooteJTK on combat data

```{r}
#Load seurat object with combated assay:
load("../examples_fixed_acrophase/figures/mouse_SCN/mouse_SCN_neuronSubset_seurat_obj_w_combat_assay.RData")

orpheus_inputs_combat = calculate_orpheus_inputs(s_obj, groups_to_analyze = c("avp/nms","cck/bdnf","cck/c1ql3","vip/grp", "vip/nms"), grouping_var = "neuron_subcluster", assay_to_use = "ORPHEUS_norm_ComBat" )

write_bootejtk <- function(df, outfile) {
  # Ensure data frame with GeneID as first column
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  df <- cbind(GeneID = rownames(df), df)
  
  # Extract timepoints
  timepoints <- colnames(df)[-1]   # skip GeneID
  
  # BooteJTK requires a header like:
  # #    ZT0   ZT4  ZT8 ...
  header <- paste0("#\t", paste0("ZT", timepoints, collapse = "\t"))
  
  # Write header
  writeLines(header, con = outfile)
  
  # Append table
  write.table(
    df,
    file       = outfile,
    append     = TRUE,
    quote      = FALSE,
    sep        = "\t",
    row.names  = FALSE,
    col.names  = FALSE,
    na         = "NA"
  )
}

pad_timepoints <- function(df, all_timepoints) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  current_tp <- colnames(df)
  
  # Add missing timepoints as NA columns
  missing_tp <- setdiff(all_timepoints, current_tp)
  if (length(missing_tp) > 0) {
    for (tp in missing_tp) {
      df[[tp]] <- NA
    }
  }
  
  # Order columns chronologically
  df <- df[, gtools::mixedsort(colnames(df))]
  return(df)
}

write_all_bootejtk <- function(nested_list, outdir) {
  dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # Determine master set of timepoints across all dataframes
  all_tps <- unique(unlist(
    lapply(nested_list, function(x) {
      c(colnames(x[[1]]), colnames(x[[2]]))
    })
  ))
  
  for (name in names(nested_list)) {
    item <- nested_list[[name]]
    
    df1 <- pad_timepoints(item[[1]], all_tps)
    # df2 <- pad_timepoints(item[[2]], all_tps)
    
    safe_name = stringr::str_replace(name, "/", "")
    # Write each dataframe to its own file
    outfile1 <- file.path(outdir, paste0(safe_name, "_pb.txt"))
    # outfile2 <- file.path(outdir, paste0(safe_name, "_var.txt"))
    
    write_bootejtk(df1, outfile1)
    # write_bootejtk(df2, outfile2)
  }
}
```

### Prepare variance signal for eJTK

Now we need to isolate the 12-hr rhythms in variance to give to ejtk. Below I use regression to isolate the 12-hr components of variance 2 ways: modeling the variance without any priors about phase, and 2) using the phase from ejtk on bulk data. In both cases I subtract out the contribution of variance from the 24-hr rhythm and non-rhythm.

```{r}
prepare_var_for_ejtk <- function(times, var_mat, mean_mat, pb_phase_file, pb_cycling_sig_cutoff = 0.05) {
   cat(paste("\nPreparing variance data for eJTK, input times must be regularly spaced, e.g. 0-24 and in hrs units\n"))
   if(length(unique(diff(times))) != 1){
     stop("Error: times must be regularly spaced in hrs units")
   }
  `%do%` <- foreach::`%do%`
  pb_phases = read.delim(pb_phase_file, header=TRUE, sep="\t", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  
  sig_genes = dplyr::filter(pb_phases, as.numeric(GammaP)< pb_cycling_sig_cutoff)
  
  keep_genes = sig_genes$ID %>% unname %>% unlist
  var_mat = var_mat[keep_genes,]
  mean_mat = mean_mat[keep_genes,]
  
  # Transpose matrices to have subjects x genes
  var_data <- t(var_mat)
  means1 <- t(mean_mat)
  times_rads = times * pi/12
  # Initialize matrices to store the double freq signals, mean rhythms
  double_freq_mat_free <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  mean_rhythm_matrix_free <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))

  double_freq_mat_fixed <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  
  double_freq_mat_residual <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  # pb_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  # var_mesor_values <- numeric(ncol(var_data))  # Store var_mesor for each gene
  rownames(double_freq_mat_free) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(double_freq_mat_free) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  rownames(mean_rhythm_matrix_free) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(mean_rhythm_matrix_free) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  rownames(double_freq_mat_fixed) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(double_freq_mat_fixed) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  rownames(mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  rownames(double_freq_mat_residual) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(double_freq_mat_residual) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  
  # Loop through genes to calculate the double-frequency component, mean rhythm, and pseudobulk rhythm
  foreach(gene_i = 1:ncol(var_data)) %do% {
    gene_symbol = colnames(var_data)[gene_i]
    ejtk_bulk_phase = pb_phases$PhaseMean[pb_phases$ID == gene_symbol]
    ejtk_bulk_phase_rads = ejtk_bulk_phase * pi / 12
    stopifnot(ejtk_bulk_phase_rads >= 0 & ejtk_bulk_phase_rads <= 2*pi)
    stopifnot(rlang::is_empty(ejtk_bulk_phase) == FALSE)
    
    gexp1 <- as.numeric(unlist(var_data[, gene_i]))
    m1 <- as.numeric(unlist(means1[, gene_i]))

    # Fit the variance model
    var_model_free <- lm(gexp1 ~ sin(2 *times_rads) + cos(2 * times_rads) + m1)
    design_matrix_free <- model.matrix(gexp1 ~ sin(2 * times_rads) + cos(2 * times_rads) + m1)


    double_wave = cos(2 * (times_rads- pi/2 - ejtk_bulk_phase_rads))
    var_model_fixed = lm(gexp1 ~ double_wave + m1)
    design_matrix_fixed <- model.matrix(gexp1 ~ double_wave + m1)
    
    var_model_residual = lm(gexp1 ~ m1)


    sv <- svd(design_matrix_free)$d
    sv2 <- svd(design_matrix_fixed)$d
    tol <- 1e-14
    rankX <- sum(sv > tol)
    rankX2 <- sum(sv2 > tol)
    full <- ncol(design_matrix_free)
    full2 <- ncol(design_matrix_fixed)

    if (rankX < full || rankX2 < full2) {
      # design matrix is rank-deficient -> at least one coef would be NA
      message(paste("Skipping gene", gene_symbol, "due to rank-deficient design matrix"))
      return(NULL)
    }

    if (var_model_free$coefficients[["m1"]] < 0 || var_model_fixed$coefficients[["m1"]] < 0 || var_model_residual$coefficients[["m1"]] < 0) {
      # If the coefficient for m1 is negative, skip this gene
      message(paste("Skipping gene", colnames(var_data)[gene_i], "due to mean coefficient < 0 in variance model"))
      return(NULL)
    } else {  
    # var_mesor <- mean(var_model_free$fitted.values)
    var_mesor_free <- mean(design_matrix_free[,-c(2, 3)] %*% var_model_free[["coefficients"]][-c(2,3)])
    var_mesor_fixed <- mean(design_matrix_fixed[,-2] %*% var_model_fixed[["coefficients"]][-2])
    # var_mesor_values[gene_i] <- var_mesor  # Store var_mesor for this gene

    # Calculate the double frequency signal (double-frequency component)
    circ <- gexp1 - design_matrix_free[, -c(2, 3)] %*% var_model_free[["coefficients"]][-c(2, 3)]
    double_freq_mat_free[gene_i, ] <- circ

    circ_fixed <- gexp1 - design_matrix_fixed[, -2] %*% var_model_fixed[["coefficients"]][-2]
    double_freq_mat_fixed[gene_i, ] <- circ_fixed
  
    double_freq_mat_residual[gene_i, ] <- var_model_residual$residuals
    
    # Calculate the mean rhythm
    mean_rhythm <- var_model_free$coefficients[["m1"]] * m1
    mean_rhythm_matrix_free[gene_i, ] <- mean_rhythm

    mean_rhythm_fixed <- var_model_fixed$coefficients[["m1"]] * m1
    mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed[gene_i, ] <- mean_rhythm_fixed

    # Calculate the pseudobulk rhythm (just m1)
    # pb_mat[gene_i, ] <- m1
  }
  }
  return(list(double_freq_mat_free = double_freq_mat_free, double_freq_mat_fixed = double_freq_mat_fixed, fund_rhythm_matrix_free = mean_rhythm_matrix_free, fund_rhythm_matrix_fixed = mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed, double_freq_mat_residual = double_freq_mat_residual))
}
```

### Compare pb acrophases to 12hr var acrophases when acrophases are not contrained (in the regression step for preparing the variance or in the eJTK steps where phases are supplied)

```{r}

plot_free_acrodiff_ejtk = function(cell_type, var_sig = 0.05){
  pb_path = paste0("~/Documents/eJTK/BooteJTK/mouse_SCN_pb/ejtk_pb_results/",cell_type, "_pb_Vash__boot10-rep2_GammaP.txt")
  # var_path = paste0("~/Documents/eJTK/BooteJTK/mouse_SCN_var_nov26/", cell_type, "_double_freq_mat_free_Vash__boot10-rep4_GammaP.txt")
    var_path = paste0("~/Documents/eJTK/BooteJTK/mouse_SCN_var/", cell_type, "_double_freq_mat_residual_Vash__boot10-rep4_GammaP.txt")

  pb_jtk_res = read.delim(pb_path, sep = "\t")
  var_jtk_res = read.delim(var_path, sep = "\t")

  merged_res = merge(pb_jtk_res, var_jtk_res, by = "ID", suffixes = c("_pb", "_var"))

  merged_filt = dplyr::filter(merged_res, GammaP_var < var_sig) %>% mutate(acrodiff = (PhaseMean_var - PhaseMean_pb) %% 12)

 hist(merged_filt$acrodiff, main = cell_type, breaks = seq(0, 12, by = 2))
}

sapply(c("avpnms", "vipgrp", "vipnms", "cckc1ql3"), plot_free_acrodiff_ejtk, var_sig = 0.1)
```

### ORPHEUS on genes provided by BootEJTK

Given significant cyclers from Bootejtk on pseudobulk, and targeted 12-hr rhythms in variance, rerun my regression, ignoring any significance cutoffs from regression.

```{r}

# var_p_value = 0.1
var_p_value = 0.05
cluster_phis = list()
for(cell_type in c("avp/nms","cck/c1ql3", "vip/grp","vip/nms")){
cell_type_str = str_remove(cell_type, "/")
message("Looking at celltype: ", cell_type_str)
var_path = paste0("~/Documents/eJTK/BooteJTK/", cell_type_str, "_targeted_results_fixedAcroRegression_2hr_width.txt")
message("12hr rhtyhms from ", var_path)
SCN_var = read.delim(var_path)
pb_path = paste0("~/Documents/eJTK/BooteJTK/mouse_SCN_pb/ejtk_pb_results/", cell_type_str, "_pb_Vash__boot10-rep2_GammaP.txt")
message("24hr rhythms from ", pb_path)
SCN_pb = read.delim(pb_path)

merged_res = merge(SCN_var, SCN_pb, by.x = "Gene", by.y = "ID", suffixes = c("_var", "_pb")) %>% filter(Pvalue < var_p_value & GammaP < 0.05) %>% mutate(acrodiff = (PhaseMean12 - PhaseMean) %% 12)

ejtk_sig_genes = merged_res$Gene %>% unname %>% unlist

tmp = orpheus_inputs_combat[[cell_type]]
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]


#Recover time in hours that sample was collected

matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
# print(ZT)


pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat = pb_mat, time_units = "hrs")


phase_pb = pb_cycling %>% select(Gene_Symbols, acrophase_bulk)
var_mat = var_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]
pb_mat = pb_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]
stopifnot(all(rownames(pb_mat) == pb_cycling$Gene_Symbols))
stopifnot(all(rownames(pb_mat) == rownames(var_mat)))
phase_pb_num = phase_pb$acrophase_bulk %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric
#hist(as.numeric(phase_pb))
var_cyclers = var_cycling_fix_acro(times = ZT, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = phase_pb_num)

bulk_amp_thr = 0.05

input_cos = var_cyclers %>%
    left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix=c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    # filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
    #mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_amp_thr) %>%
    filter(Gene_Symbols %in% ejtk_sig_genes) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")
    # filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)

 # Calculate phi parameters
phi = input_cos %>%
        apply(., 1, function(row) {
            suppressWarnings(
                 find_analytic(row[1], row[2], row[3], row[4])
                 )
        }) %>%
        t %>%
        as.data.frame

colnames(phi) = c("G", "Ac", "theta", "phi")
output = merge(phi, input_cos, by = 0)

local_res =  list("tmm" = output)
names(local_res) =cell_type_str
cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))


# cosine_vs_jtk = merge(vipgrp, input_cos, by.x = "Gene", by.y = 0)
# plot(cosine_vs_jtk$PhaseMean, cosine_vs_jtk$acrophase_bulk*12/pi)
# lines(c(0,100), c(0,100))
# plot(cosine_vs_jtk$PhaseMean12, cosine_vs_jtk$acrophase_bulk)
# lines(c(0,100), c(0,100))
# plot(cosine_vs_jtk$Max_Amp_pb/2, cosine_vs_jtk$amplitude_bulk)
# lines(c(0,100), c(0,100))
# plot(cosine_vs_jtk$Max_Amp_var/2, abs(cosine_vs_jtk$double_freq_amplitude))
# lines(c(0,100), c(0,100))
}
cos_phis_tmm <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_phis), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- cluster_phis[[source_name]][[1]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_phis[[source_name]][1])
  current_df
}))


cos_phis_tmm_filt = filter(cos_phis_tmm, !is.nan(phi))
table(cos_phis_tmm_filt$Source)


# save(cos_phis_tmm, file = "./figures/mouse_SCN/COMBAT_mouse_SCN_neuronSubtype_phis_EJTK_list_to_regression_varPthr05.RData")


```

### ORHPEUS on genes provided by BootEJTK: y \~ pb residuals

This means when I am preparing my variance data for Bootejtk, I fit the data with y \~ pb, then return the residuals of that model for BootEJTK.

```{r}
# var_p_value = 0.1
var_p_value = 0.05
cluster_phis = list()
for(cell_type in c("avp/nms","cck/c1ql3", "vip/grp","vip/nms")){
cell_type_str = str_remove(cell_type, "/")
message("Looking at celltype: ", cell_type_str)
var_path = paste0("~/Documents/eJTK/BooteJTK/", cell_type_str, "_targeted_results_ResidualAcroRegression_2hr_width.txt")
message("12hr rhtyhms from ", var_path)
SCN_var = read.delim(var_path)
pb_path = paste0("~/Documents/eJTK/BooteJTK/mouse_SCN_pb/ejtk_pb_results/", cell_type_str, "_pb_Vash__boot10-rep2_GammaP.txt")
message("24hr rhythms from ", pb_path)
SCN_pb = read.delim(pb_path)

merged_res = merge(SCN_var, SCN_pb, by.x = "Gene", by.y = "ID", suffixes = c("_var", "_pb")) %>% filter(Pvalue < var_p_value & GammaP < 0.05) %>% mutate(acrodiff = (PhaseMean12 - PhaseMean) %% 12)

ejtk_sig_genes = merged_res$Gene %>% unname %>% unlist

tmp = orpheus_inputs_combat[[cell_type]]
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]


#Recover time in hours that sample was collected

matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
# print(ZT)


pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat = pb_mat, time_units = "hrs")


phase_pb = pb_cycling %>% select(Gene_Symbols, acrophase_bulk)
var_mat = var_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]
pb_mat = pb_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]
stopifnot(all(rownames(pb_mat) == pb_cycling$Gene_Symbols))
stopifnot(all(rownames(pb_mat) == rownames(var_mat)))
phase_pb_num = phase_pb$acrophase_bulk %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric
#hist(as.numeric(phase_pb))
var_cyclers = var_cycling_fix_acro(times = ZT, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = phase_pb_num)

bulk_amp_thr = 0.05

input_cos = var_cyclers %>%
    left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix=c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    # filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
    #mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_amp_thr) %>%
    filter(Gene_Symbols %in% ejtk_sig_genes) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")
    # filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)

 # Calculate phi parameters
phi = input_cos %>%
        apply(., 1, function(row) {
            suppressWarnings(
                 find_analytic(row[1], row[2], row[3], row[4])
                 )
        }) %>%
        t %>%
        as.data.frame

colnames(phi) = c("G", "Ac", "theta", "phi")
output = merge(phi, input_cos, by = 0)

local_res =  list("tmm" = output)
names(local_res) =cell_type_str
cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))


# cosine_vs_jtk = merge(vipgrp, input_cos, by.x = "Gene", by.y = 0)
# plot(cosine_vs_jtk$PhaseMean, cosine_vs_jtk$acrophase_bulk*12/pi)
# lines(c(0,100), c(0,100))
# plot(cosine_vs_jtk$PhaseMean12, cosine_vs_jtk$acrophase_bulk)
# lines(c(0,100), c(0,100))
# plot(cosine_vs_jtk$Max_Amp_pb/2, cosine_vs_jtk$amplitude_bulk)
# lines(c(0,100), c(0,100))
# plot(cosine_vs_jtk$Max_Amp_var/2, abs(cosine_vs_jtk$double_freq_amplitude))
# lines(c(0,100), c(0,100))
}
cos_phis_tmm <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_phis), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- cluster_phis[[source_name]][[1]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_phis[[source_name]][1])
  current_df
}))
```

### OPRHEUS on coarse clusters:

```{r}
library(sva)
load("../../Mouse_SCN/mouse_SCN_seurat_obj.RData")


s_obj = prepare_seurat_for_orpheus(seurat_obj = joined_seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", min_prop = 0.001 )

log_norm_counts <- log1p(s_obj@assays$ORPHEUS_norm$counts)  # log(1 + x)

batches = s_obj@meta.data$batch

combat_corrected <- ComBat(
  dat = as.matrix(log_norm_counts),
  batch = batches,
  par.prior = TRUE,
  prior.plots = FALSE
)

combat_corrected_exp <- expm1(combat_corrected)

s_obj[["ORPHEUS_norm_ComBat_logged"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = combat_corrected)
s_obj[["ORPHEUS_norm_ComBat"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = combat_corrected_exp)

load("~/Desktop/mouse_SCN_w_combat_assay_all_celltypes.RData")
orpheus_inputs_combat = calculate_orpheus_inputs(s_obj, groups_to_analyze = unique(s_obj$cluster), grouping_var = "cluster", assay_to_use = "ORPHEUS_norm_ComBat" )

cluster_phis = list()

for( cell_type in names(orpheus_inputs_combat)){
cell_type_str = str_replace_all(cell_type, "/", "")

tmp = orpheus_inputs_combat[[cell_type]]
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]


#Recover time in hours that sample was collected

matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
print(ZT)

vars = sparseMatrixStats::rowVars(counts)
means = sparseMatrixStats::rowMeans2(counts)
agg_theta_meas = data.frame(coarse_theta = (vars-means)/means^2)
rownames(agg_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)
times = colnames(orpheus_inputs_combat$`avp/nms`$pseudobulk_tmm_matrix) %>% as.numeric

pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat = pb_mat, time_units = "hrs")

phase_pb = pb_cycling %>% select(Gene_Symbols, acrophase_bulk)
var_mat = var_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]
pb_mat = pb_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]
stopifnot(all(rownames(pb_mat) == pb_cycling$Gene_Symbols))
stopifnot(all(rownames(pb_mat) == rownames(var_mat)))
phase_pb_num = phase_pb$acrophase_bulk %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric
#hist(as.numeric(phase_pb))
var_cyclers = var_cycling_fix_acro(times = ZT, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = phase_pb_num)

bulk_amp_thr = 0.05
input_cos = var_cyclers %>%
    left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix=c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
    #mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_amp_thr) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)

phi <- tryCatch(
  {
    calc_phi(pb_cycling, var_cyclers, cycling_p_thr = 0.05, bulk_amp_thr = bulk_amp_thr)
  },
  error = function(e) {
    message("calc_phi failed: ", e$message)
    return(NA)
  }
)
if(all(is.na(phi))){
 next
}

output_cos_tmm = merge(phi, input_cos, by = 0)
output = merge(output_cos_tmm, agg_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)


local_res =  list("tmm" = output)
names(local_res) =cell_type
cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))


}

cos_phis_tmm <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_phis), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- cluster_phis[[source_name]][[1]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_phis[[source_name]][1])
  current_df
}))

# save(cos_phis_tmm, file = "figures/mouse_SCN/COMBAT_mouse_SCN_neuronSubtype_phis.RData")

cos_phis_tmm_filt = filter(cos_phis_tmm, !is.nan(phi))
table(cos_phis_tmm_filt$Source)
```

```{r}
  batch = batches,
  par.prior = TRUE,
  prior.plots = FALSE
)

combat_corrected_exp <- expm1(combat_corrected)

s_obj[["ORPHEUS_norm_ComBat_logged"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = combat_corrected)
s_obj[["ORPHEUS_norm_ComBat"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = combat_corrected_exp)

seeds <- c(1,2,3,4)
#Initialize an empty list to store all results
all_results_combined <- list()
for(i in seeds){
  message(paste("--- Running ORPHEUS with seed:", i, "---"))
    
    # returns a list like: list('CellTypeA' = ..., 'CellTypeB' = ...)
    results_one_seed <- calculate_orpheus_inputs(
      s_obj, 
      groups_to_analyze = c("Neurons"), 
      grouping_var = "coarse_clusters", 
      assay_to_use = "ORPHEUS_norm_ComBat",
      num_replicates = 2, 
      random_seed = i
    )
    
    
    # Modify the names to include the seed identifier
    # prevents name clashes when we combine the lists.
    original_names <- names(results_one_seed)
    new_names <- paste0(original_names, "_seed", i)
    names(results_one_seed) <- new_names
    
    # Append the newly named results to main list
    all_results_combined <- c(all_results_combined, results_one_seed)
}
# Check the names of the final combined list
print("Names of the final combined list:")
print(names(all_results_combined))

all_results_combined_sans_counts <- lapply(all_results_combined, function(x) x[-3])

save(all_results_combined_sans_counts, file = "~/Desktop/mouse_Neurons_combinedCells_4_seeds_pb_var_counts_list.RData")
#######Load results from above #######
load("./figures/mouse_SCN/mouse_Neurons_combinedCells_4_seeds_pb_var_counts_list.RData")

cluster_phis = list()
for(cell_type in names(all_results_combined)){
  
print(paste("Analyzing", cell_type))


# tmp = extract_clstr_prep_input(seurat_obj, cluster_id = cell_type, clip_sd = 15, normalize = T)
tmp = all_results_combined[[cell_type]]
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]


vars = sparseMatrixStats::rowVars(counts)
means = sparseMatrixStats::rowMeans2(counts)
agg_theta_meas = data.frame(coarse_theta = (vars-means)/means^2)
rownames(agg_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)


#Recover time in hours that sample was collected
matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
print(ZT)

#rename cols to use is_cycling_custom
colnames(pb_mat) = str_replace(colnames(pb_mat), "_rep[1-9]*", "") 
stopifnot(all.equal(as.numeric(colnames(pb_mat)), ZT))

#Call cosinor regression methods, where phases of variance wave are fixed:
pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat, time_units = "hrs")
# pb_cycling = is_cycling_custom(ZT, pb_mat, meta_data = pseudorep_meta, time_units = "hrs")
# test = merge(pb_cycling1, pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffixes = c("", "_batch")) %>%   mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric))
# plot(test$acrophase_bulk, test$acrophase_bulk_batch)

phase_pb = pb_cycling %>% select(Gene_Symbols, acrophase_bulk)

var_mat = var_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]
pb_mat = pb_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]

stopifnot(all(rownames(pb_mat) == pb_cycling$Gene_Symbols))
stopifnot(all(rownames(pb_mat) == rownames(var_mat)))

phase_pb_num = phase_pb$acrophase_bulk %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric
#hist(as.numeric(phase_pb))

var_cyclers = var_cycling_fix_acro(times = ZT, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = phase_pb_num)
# var_cyclers = var_cycling(times = ZT, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = phase_pb_num)

bulk_amp_thr = 0.1

input_cos = var_cyclers %>% 
    left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix=c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
    #mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_amp_thr) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)

phi <- tryCatch(
  {
    calc_phi(pb_cycling, var_cyclers, cycling_p_thr = 0.05, bulk_amp_thr = bulk_amp_thr)
  },
  error = function(e) {
    message("calc_phi failed: ", e$message)
    return(NA)   
  }
)
if(all(is.na(phi))){
 next
}

# plot_rhythms(ZT, var_mat, pb_mat, plot_me = c("Akap17b"))

output_cos_tmm = merge(phi, input_cos, by = 0)
# output = merge(output_cos_tmm, time_wise_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)
output = merge(output_cos_tmm, agg_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)


local_res =  list("tmm" = output)
names(local_res) =cell_type
cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))
}

cos_phis_tmm <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_phis), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- cluster_phis[[source_name]][[1]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_phis[[source_name]][1])
  current_df
}))
```

```{r}
run_meta2d <- function(df,
                      timepoints,
                      out_file,
                      out_dir,
                      minper = 24,
                      maxper = 24,
                      cycMethod = c("JTK"),
                      ...){
  cat("\nIdentifying rhythms using MetaCycle\n")

  # Write data files to text files for MetaCycle
  df = cbind("Genes"=rownames(df), df)
  utils::write.table(df, file=out_file,sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)

  MetaCycle::meta2d(infile=out_file,
                    filestyle="txt",
                    outdir=out_dir,
                    timepoints=timepoints,
                    minper = minper, maxper = maxper,
                    cycMethod = cycMethod,
                    ...)
}
```
